editorial.blurb: Oni Maki has become Chicago's go-to matcha destination, where high-quality drinks meet fresh handrolls and made-to-order onigiri in a vibrant, Instagram-worthy setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit on weekday afternoons (like Thursday at 2:45pm) to avoid lines, and order the mango sticky rice matcha at 50% sugar or lower—reviewers consistently rave about this signature drink and warn that even half-sugar is quite sweet.

topDishes.note: Vibrant green, umami-rich matcha with fresh mango and creamy rice texture at the bottom
Fresh and crispy seaweed with excellent texture
Perfectly balanced heat with crunchy, quality seaweed
